item.title: Introducing KindFi News: Updates from Our Team, Projects, and Causes
item.content:encoded:
# Introducing KindFi News: Updates from Our Team, Projects, and Causes
We launched KindFi News—a fast, MDX-powered blog for product updates, impact stories, and milestone reports across LATAM.
We’ve just shipped **KindFi News**—your new home for platform updates, product releases, and transparent stories from the projects and causes listed on KindFi. It’s fast, simple, and built to help more people discover verifiable impact across LATAM.
- Visit the hub: **[KindFi News](/news)** - Discover active campaigns: **[Explore Projects](/projects)**
## What’s included today {#whats-included-today}
- **Platform updates & release notes** Roadmaps, UI improvements, and behind-the-scenes changes that make KindFi better.
- **Project & cause posts** Listed projects can publish **impact stories, milestone reports, and updates** directly on KindFi—no extra tools required.
- **Proof-friendly content** Posts can include references to **milestone-based escrow** and on-chain activity to back up claims with verifiable data.
> **Transparent by design** > KindFi integrates **escrow on Stellar**, enabling projects to report > milestones with links to on-chain references for donors to verify.
## For projects: publish your first post {#for-projects-publish-your-first-post}
1. Go to your project page and open **Updates**. 2. Click **New Post**, add a clear title, a 1–2 sentence summary, and a cover image. 3. Tag it by **category** (e.g., education, clean water) and **region**. 4. Reference the **milestone** you’re reporting on—include any relevant on-chain links.
> **Tip for better reach** > Use specific, outcome-focused titles (e.g., “50 filters installed in > Puntarenas, Costa Rica”) and include costs, photos, and verification details.
## For donors and supporters {#for-donors-and-supporters}
- **Follow along in one place**: Read all updates on **[KindFi News](/news)** or on each project’s **Updates** tab. - **Subscribe via RSS**: Add **/news/rss** to your reader to get new posts. - **Share impact stories**: Posts include rich previews for X, LinkedIn, and WhatsApp.
## Content you’ll see often {#content-youll-see-often}
- **Impact stories**: People helped, before/after, and measurable outcomes. - **Milestone reports**: What was delivered, costs, and links to escrow releases. - **Product notes**: Small quality-of-life improvements that make KindFi faster and easier. - **Partner spotlights**: Collaboration across the Stellar ecosystem to unlock more good.
---
If you’re building for social impact in LATAM and want your work to be discoverable and verifiable, you’re in the right place. Start reading on **[KindFi News](/news)** or head to **[Projects](/projects)** to follow a cause and get notified when new posts go live.

item.title: See You in Rio: KindFi at Stellar Meridian 2025 — with Costa Rica’s Trustless Work Ecosystem
item.content:encoded:
# See You in Rio: KindFi at Stellar Meridian 2025 — with Costa Rica’s Trustless Work Ecosystem
We’re excited to share that **KindFi is attending Meridian 2025**—Stellar’s flagship conference—taking place **September 17–18, 2025 at the Copacabana Palace in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil**. The theme this year is **“The Blueprint”**, bringing together builders, founders, policymakers, and ecosystem partners focused on real-world finance and open blockchain innovation.
> **Heading to Rio? Let’s connect** > > If you’re building around **escrow, stablecoins, real-world impact, or > transparent crowdfunding**, we’d love to meet. We’ll be on site both > conference days and during the hackathon window.
## Who’s traveling with us {#whos-traveling-with-us}
We’re proud to highlight fellow Costa Rica projects from the **Trustless Work** ecosystem who will also be in the mix:
- **Trustless Work** — Stellar-based **escrow infrastructure** powering milestone-based, non-custodial payments. - **GrantFox** — Open-source **grants & milestone payouts** platform using Trustless Work smart escrows. - **Pacto** — Local P2P trading and on/off-ramps where every trade is secured with **Trustless Work escrows**.
These tools help us make **transparent, verifiable crowdfunding** possible across LATAM—exactly the kind of practical innovation Meridian celebrates.
## Why Meridian matters for KindFi {#why-meridian-matters-for-kindfi}
- **Real partnerships, faster shipping**: Two days of workshops, technical talks, and founder-to-founder conversations designed to move products from zero to one. - **HackMeridian**: Ahead of the main event, the official hackathon (Sept 15–16) is a great space to prototype integrations and form teams. - **Focus areas we care about**: stablecoins, tokenization, DeFi, compliance, smart contracts, payments, and interoperability—core to how we run escrow-first crowdfunding.
## Find us in Rio {#find-us-in-rio}
- **Dates**: Sept 17–18 (main conference) - **Venue**: Copacabana Palace, Rio de Janeiro - **Pre-events**: HackMeridian (Sept 15–16)
Want to meet? Send us a note via **/contact**, or ping us on X/LinkedIn. If you’re a project operating in **education, clean water, disaster relief, animal welfare, or community development** and want **milestone-based funding** with on-chain references, come talk to us.
> **Let’s collaborate** > > Running a Stellar-powered product and want to add **milestone escrows** or > **verifiable updates** to your funding flow? We’ll be happy to whiteboard > ideas at the venue.
See you in Rio.

item.title: Crowdfunding for Social Impact in LATAM: A Practical, Transparent Path
item.content:encoded:
Crowdfunding is one of the fastest ways to fund real-world impact across Latin America—but donors need **clarity, proof, and progress**. This guide outlines how projects can run **transparent, milestone-based campaigns** on KindFi to earn trust and convert supporters into long-term backers.
## Why LATAM projects struggle with traditional crowdfunding
- **High friction and fees** for international payments. - **Low donor confidence** due to vague outcomes and limited reporting. - **One-off campaigns** that don't build a repeatable funding engine.
> **The KindFi approach** > KindFi uses **milestone-based escrow on Stellar** (via Trustless Work) so > funds are released when specific milestones are verified. Donors see **what > was promised**, **what was delivered**, and **when funds moved**.
## What donors actually want to see
- A **clear problem statement** and who benefits. - **Specific milestones** with costs and timelines. - **On-chain or verifiable references** when funds are released. - **Photos, receipts, and short updates** proving delivery.
## How to structure a LATAM-ready campaign
### 1) Define milestones with budgets
Break your goal into 2–5 milestones. Each milestone should have a deliverable, target date, and budget.
| Milestone | Deliverable | Cost (USD) | Target Date | Proof | |-----------|-------------|------------|-------------|-------| | Water filters | Install 50 family filters in Puntarenas | 3,250 | 2025-10-15 | Photos, beneficiary list, GPS | | Training | Hygiene workshops for 50 families | 600 | 2025-10-20 | Attendance sheets | | Audit | Independent verification & report | 350 | 2025-10-25 | PDF report |
### 2) Publish a short, outcome-focused story
Lead with the **benefit**, not the tool. "50 families get clean water for under $70 each" beats "We're raising money for equipment."
### 3) Add transparent release criteria
State how you'll prove completion (e.g., receipts, photos, reports, on-chain reference). Use the **Updates** tab to show progress.
### 4) Use media that travels well
- 1 cover image (1200×630) and 2–5 progress photos. - Short video (≤30s) for social. - Captions that mention **city, country, and outcome**.
> **Copy-and-paste CTA for your socials** > "Help us fund clean water for 50 families in Puntarenas, Costa Rica. Every > tranche is released on milestone completion, verified on-chain. Read the plan > and follow updates on KindFi: /projects"
## Categories that perform well in LATAM
- **Clean water** and sanitation - **Education** (equipment, connectivity, scholarships) - **Disaster relief** (rapid deployments) - **Animal rescue** and welfare - **Health access** (clinics, screenings, supplies) - **Community development** (lighting, parks, safety)
## Your 7-day launch checklist
- Write a **150–200 word** campaign overview with the outcome in the first sentence. - Define **2–5 milestones** with costs and proof. - Prepare **1 cover** + **3 progress photos**. - Publish your campaign on KindFi and add the **first update** (what's next, when, and how you'll verify). - Share the campaign link with a **city/country hashtag** for local discovery. - Schedule **weekly updates** (even if short) until all milestones are complete.
## Why projects choose KindFi
- **Milestone-based escrow** builds trust and increases completion rates. - **Friction-light cross-border** funding on Stellar. - **Built-in updates** and shareable previews for X, LinkedIn, and WhatsApp. - **Project pages** that grow with your results, not just one campaign.
---
Ready to launch a transparent campaign in LATAM? Explore active causes on **[Projects](/projects)** or **[contact us](/contact)** to list your organization and publish your first milestone plan.
